head: My Bookmarks app for iPhone saves links from any app, with a PIN vault
dek: My Bookmarks is a 2.99 dollar bookmarks app for iPhone and iPad that saves links from Safari, Chrome or any app through the Share button and keeps them on your device. It was #78 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 18 November, five days after it came out.
details: You sort links into groups and categories, add tags, notes and favorites, and search titles, links, notes and tags at once. A Vault hides chosen links behind a PIN and Face ID and opens them inside the app, so they stay out of your browser history. Bookmarks from Safari, Chrome, Firefox or Edge on a computer can be imported, and backups go to iCloud Drive or Files. There's no account, no ads, no tracking and no subscription; it's made by Sudip Choudhury.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, 2.99 dollars once
means: If your saved links are spread over several browsers, this keeps them in one list on your iPhone without an account.
todo: Look for My Bookmarks by SC360 on the App Store; it needs iOS 17 or later.
thumb_words: ALL YOUR LINKS IN ONE PRIVATE APP
